## Luka Sucevic - Mississippi State Tennis
**Luka Sucevic** was a men's tennis player at **Mississippi State University** (2015-16 season). He was a freshman from Belgrade, Serbia who posted an 11-5 singles record and 8-7 doubles record. He clinched three matches for the Bulldogs against UAB, Auburn, and Alabama.

## Luka Andonov / Luka Rodic - Alcorn State Tennis
**Luka Andonov** and **Luka Rodic** are tennis players at **Alcorn State University** in Lorman, Mississippi. They have competed in doubles together and are part of the Braves men's tennis team.

## Luka Sari - East Mississippi Community College Soccer
**Luka Sari** is a sophomore midfielder from Zrenjanin, Serbia playing soccer at **East Mississippi Community College**.

## Luka Kecman - Delta State Basketball
**Luka Kecman** was previously on the **Delta State University** basketball roster but has since left the team.

## Luka Dončić Connection
While **Luka Dončić** (the NBA superstar) never attended any Mississippi university, he is mentioned as a favorite athlete by **Drake Pond**, a football player at Midwestern State University who previously played at East Central Community College in Decatur, Mississippi.
